LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary (F-01-57) is a scarred WAW huntress who can be commissioned for 15 PE-Boxes to hunt hostile threats on the map.\nBeware: other Abnormalities breaching will agitate her Qliphoth Counter until she breaks free on her own.
